title: Ergodic Theory
description: A system that, given time, passes through every state open to it: averaging over time is then the same as averaging over all states. Unlocks the Markov Chain Refinery and the Ergodic Mixer Core.

puzzle.goal: Two copies of a chaotic system start a distance x apart, and the gap grows by a factor e^λ every second. Write the gap X after t seconds.
puzzle.name: Lyapunov divergence
puzzle.ask: Find X for x = @{x}, L = @{L} per second (for λ) and t = @{t} s.
puzzle.method: A small gap grows in proportion to itself: dX/dt = λX. That is why a chaotic system forgets where it began, and mixes.
